    // ==================== MODULE 2: COMPOSITION ANALYZER (5-STEP FLORAL LAB) ====================
    const compCanvas = document.getElementById('compCanvas');
    const compCtx = compCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    let compBgImg = new Image();
    let activeCompTool = 'focal';
    let activeCompColor = '#E11D48';
    let isDrawingComp = false;
    let compStart = null, compCurrent = null;
    let compZoom = 1, compPanX = 0, compPanY = 0;
    let compAutoResult = null;

    function updateCompZoomTransform() {
      compCanvas.style.transform = `translate(${compPanX}px, ${compPanY}px) scale(${compZoom})`;
      document.getElementById('compZoomLabel').textContent = Math.round(compZoom * 100) + '%';
    }

    function loadCompImage(src) {
      compBgImg = new Image();
      compBgImg.onload = () => {
        const maxW = 760, maxH = 560;
        const scale = Math.min(maxW / compBgImg.width, maxH / compBgImg.height, 1);
        compCanvas.width = Math.round(compBgImg.width * scale);
        compCanvas.height = Math.round(compBgImg.height * scale);
        compZoom = 1; compPanX = 0; compPanY = 0;
        updateCompZoomTransform();
        analyzeFloralComposition();
        renderCompCanvas();
      };
      compBgImg.src = src;
    }

    function getSelectedCriteria() {
      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.comp-crit:checked')).map(c => c.value);
    }

    // Real Pixel-Based Organic Silhouette + 8-Group Floral Composition Analysis
    function analyzeFloralComposition() {
      const w = compCanvas.width, h = compCanvas.height;
      if (!w || !h || !compBgImg.complete || !compBgImg.naturalWidth) return;

      const off = document.createElement('canvas');
      off.width = w; off.height = h;
      const octx = off.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
      octx.drawImage(compBgImg, 0, 0, w, h);
      const data = octx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;

      // Sample wall/table background from edges
      let bgR = 0, bgG = 0, bgB = 0, bgN = 0;
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 4) {
        [1, 3, h - 2].forEach(y => {
          const idx = (y * w + x) * 4;
          bgR += data[idx]; bgG += data[idx+1]; bgB += data[idx+2]; bgN++;
        });
      }
      bgR /= bgN; bgG /= bgN; bgB /= bgN;

      const gx = 48, gy = 48;
      const cellW = w / gx, cellH = h / gy;
      let totalMass = 0, leftMass = 0, rightMass = 0, topMass = 0, botMass = 0;
      let minCX = gx, maxCX = 0, minCY = gy, maxCY = 0;
      const rowLeft = new Array(gy).fill(-1);
      const rowRight = new Array(gy).fill(-1);
      const rowWidths = new Array(gy).fill(0);
      const rowCenters = new Array(gy).fill(0.5);
      const rowCounts = new Array(gy).fill(0);
      const focalCandidates = [];

      for (let cy = 0; cy < gy; cy++) {
        let rMin = gx, rMax = -1, rSum = 0, rCnt = 0;
        for (let cx = 0; cx < gx; cx++) {
          const px = Math.floor((cx + 0.5) * cellW);
          const py = Math.floor((cy + 0.5) * cellH);
          const idx = (py * w + px) * 4;
          const r = data[idx], g = data[idx+1], b = data[idx+2];
          const diffBg = Math.hypot(r - bgR, g - bgG, b - bgB);
          const maxC = Math.max(r, g, b) / 255, minC = Math.min(r, g, b) / 255;
          const sat = maxC === 0 ? 0 : (maxC - minC) / maxC;
          const isFloral = (diffBg > 24 || sat > 0.16) && py < h * 0.93;

          if (isFloral) {
            totalMass++;
            if (cx < gx / 2) leftMass++; else rightMass++;
            if (cy < gy / 2) topMass++; else botMass++;
            if (cx < minCX) minCX = cx; if (cx > maxCX) maxCX = cx;
            if (cy < minCY) minCY = cy; if (cy > maxCY) maxCY = cy;
            if (cx < rMin) rMin = cx; if (cx > rMax) rMax = cx;
            rSum += cx; rCnt++;
            const fScore = sat * 70 + Math.min(diffBg, 90) * 0.4;
            if (py > h * 0.22 && py < h * 0.84) {
              focalCandidates.push({ score: fScore, cx: (cx + 0.5) / gx, cy: (cy + 0.5) / gy });
            }
          }
        }
        if (rCnt > 0) {
          rowLeft[cy] = rMin / gx;
          rowRight[cy] = (rMax + 1) / gx;
          rowWidths[cy] = (rMax - rMin + 1) / gx;
          rowCenters[cy] = (rSum / rCnt + 0.5) / gx;
          rowCounts[cy] = rCnt;
        }
      }

      // Build organic silhouette polygon tracing actual floral perimeter
      const silhouettePoly = [];
      for (let cy = minCY; cy <= maxCY; cy++) {
        if (rowRight[cy] >= 0) silhouettePoly.push({ x: rowRight[cy], y: (cy + 0.5) / gy });
      }
      for (let cy = maxCY; cy >= minCY; cy--) {
        if (rowLeft[cy] >= 0) silhouettePoly.push({ x: rowLeft[cy], y: (cy + 0.5) / gy });
      }

      focalCandidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      const primaryFocal = focalCandidates[0] || { cx: 0.5, cy: 0.55 };
      const secondaryFocal = focalCandidates.find(f => Math.hypot(f.cx - primaryFocal.cx, f.cy - primaryFocal.cy) > 0.22) || null;

      const boxW = Math.max(0.15, (maxCX - minCX + 1) / gx);
      const boxH = Math.max(0.2, (maxCY - minCY + 1) / gy);
      const aspectRatio = (boxH * h) / (boxW * w);
      const floralCoveragePct = Math.round((totalMass / (gx * gy)) * 100);
      const negativeSpacePct = Math.max(5, 100 - floralCoveragePct);
      const leftPct = totalMass ? Math.round((leftMass / totalMass) * 100) : 50;
      const rightPct = 100 - leftPct;
      const asymDiff = Math.abs(leftPct - rightPct);

      // Vase vs Flower height estimate (bottom ~22% of floral span vs upper 78%)
      const vasePct = Math.round(clamp(28 - (aspectRatio - 1) * 5, 18, 38));
      const flowerPct = 100 - vasePct;

      // Determine Form, Structure (Open/Closed), Layout, Rhythm, Flow
      const topW = rowWidths.slice(minCY, Math.floor(minCY + (maxCY - minCY) * 0.35)).reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, b), 0);
      const midW = rowWidths.slice(Math.floor(minCY + (maxCY - minCY) * 0.35), Math.floor(minCY + (maxCY - minCY) * 0.7)).reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, b), 0);
      const botW = rowWidths.slice(Math.floor(minCY + (maxCY - minCY) * 0.7), maxCY + 1).reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, b), 0);

      let formShape = 'Dáng Tự do (Freeform)';
      if (aspectRatio > 1.22 && asymDiff >= 8) formShape = 'Dáng Cao Bất Đối Xứng';
      else if (aspectRatio > 1.22 && topW < midW * 0.65) formShape = 'Dáng Tháp / Tam Giác Cao';
      else if (aspectRatio < 0.85) formShape = 'Dáng Ngang Trải Rộng';
      else if (Math.abs(topW - botW) < 0.14 && asymDiff < 10) formShape = 'Dáng Tròn / Vòm Cân Đối';
      else if (asymDiff >= 12) formShape = 'Dáng Lệch / Chữ L Tự Nhiên';

      const structureOpen = negativeSpacePct >= 38 ? 'Cấu trúc Mở (cành vươn thoáng ra không gian)' : 'Cấu trúc Khép (khối hoa gom gọn, chắc)';
      const layoutType = asymDiff <= 8 ? 'Bố cục Đối xứng / Hướng tâm' : secondaryFocal ? 'Bố cục Bất đối xứng đa điểm' : 'Bố cục Bất đối xứng 1 trọng tâm';
      const balanceType = asymDiff <= 8 ? `Cân bằng Đối xứng (${leftPct}% Trái – ${rightPct}% Phải)` : `Cân bằng Bất đối xứng (${leftPct}% Trái – ${rightPct}% Phải, bù trừ bằng độ vươn cành)`;
      const rhythmType = rowCounts.filter(c => c >= 3).length >= 16
        ? 'Nhịp điệu Tiệm tiến & Luân phiên (búp nhỏ vươn cao → hoa to ở giữa → nhánh rủ nhẹ)'
        : 'Nhịp điệu Lặp lại gom cụm (các bông hoa chính tập trung tạo khối dày)';

      const topX = rowCounts[Math.min(gy - 1, minCY + 2)] ? rowCenters[Math.min(gy - 1, minCY + 2)] : primaryFocal.cx;
      const botX = rowCounts[Math.max(0, maxCY - 2)] ? rowCenters[Math.max(0, maxCY - 2)] : primaryFocal.cx;

      compAutoResult = {
        silhouettePoly,
        formShape,
        structureOpen,
        layoutType,
        aspectRatio,
        vasePct,
        flowerPct,
        primaryFocal,
        secondaryFocal,
        balanceType,
        rhythmType,
        flow: { startX: topX, startY: (minCY + 1) / gy, midX: primaryFocal.cx, midY: primaryFocal.cy, endX: botX, endY: (maxCY - 1) / gy },
        floralCoveragePct,
        negativeSpacePct
      };
      renderCompDiagnosis();
    }

    function renderCompDiagnosis() {
      const r = compAutoResult;
      if (!r) return;
      const selected = getSelectedCriteria();
      document.getElementById('compFormBadge').textContent = selected.length === 8 ? 'Phân tích Tổng thể' : `${selected.length} tiêu chí`;

      const cards = {
        form: { title: '1. Hình dáng tổng thể', body: `<strong>${r.formShape}</strong>. ${r.structureOpen}. Đường nét đứt màu cam trên ảnh bám theo đường bao thực tế của cụm hoa.` },
        layout: { title: '2. Bố cục', body: `<strong>${r.layoutType}</strong>. Các cụm hoa sắp xếp rõ lớp chính – phụ.` },
        ratio: { title: '3. Tỷ lệ', body: `Tỷ lệ Cao/Rộng ≈ <strong>${r.aspectRatio.toFixed(2)}</strong>. Ước lượng phần Hoa chiếm <strong>${r.flowerPct}%</strong> và Bình/Gốc chiếm <strong>${r.vasePct}%</strong> (đạt chuẩn hài hòa).` },
        focal: { title: '4. Trọng tâm', body: `Có <strong>${r.secondaryFocal ? '2 điểm' : '1 điểm'}</strong> thu hút chính tại (${Math.round(r.primaryFocal.cx*100)}%, ${Math.round(r.primaryFocal.cy*100)}%), mức độ tập trung thị giác rõ ràng.` },
        balance: { title: '5. Cân bằng', body: `${r.balanceType}. Tổng thể đứng vững, không bị nghiêng lệch nặng một bên.` },
        rhythm: { title: '6. Nhịp điệu', body: `${r.rhythmType}.` },
        flow: { title: '7. Dòng chảy', body: `Mắt người xem bắt đầu từ <strong>ngọn cành cao</strong> → lướt qua <strong>trọng tâm chính</strong> → kết thúc ở <strong>nhánh rủ gần miệng bình</strong>.` },
        space: { title: '8. Khoảng trống', body: `Khối hoa chiếm <strong>${r.floralCoveragePct}%</strong>, khoảng trống (không gian âm) chiếm <strong>${r.negativeSpacePct}%</strong> giúp bố cục ${r.negativeSpacePct >= 35 ? 'thoáng và có chiều sâu' : 'đầy đặn, ấm cúng'}.` }
      };

      const container = document.getElementById('compDiagnosisCards');
      container.innerHTML = selected.length
        ? selected.map(k => `<div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5]"><div class="font-semibold text-[#A65A42]">${cards[k].title}</div><p class="mt-0.5 text-[#1A2621] leading-relaxed">${cards[k].body}</p></div>`).join('')
        : '<p class="text-[#5F6B64] italic">Hãy chọn ít nhất 1 tiêu chí ở Bước 2 để xem phân tích.</p>';
    }

    function renderCompCanvas() {
      if (!compCanvas.width) return;
      compCtx.clearRect(0, 0, compCanvas.width, compCanvas.height);
      if (compBgImg.complete && compBgImg.naturalWidth) {
        compCtx.drawImage(compBgImg, 0, 0, compCanvas.width, compCanvas.height);
      }

      const w = compCanvas.width, h = compCanvas.height;
      // Guides
      if (document.getElementById('guideThirds').checked) {
        compCtx.save(); compCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)'; compCtx.lineWidth = 1; compCtx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
        [1/3, 2/3].forEach(r => {
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(w*r, 0); compCtx.lineTo(w*r, h); compCtx.stroke();
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(0, h*r); compCtx.lineTo(w, h*r); compCtx.stroke();
        });
        compCtx.restore();
      }
      if (document.getElementById('guideGolden').checked) {
        compCtx.save(); compCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(245,158,11,0.75)'; compCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        [0.382, 0.618].forEach(r => {
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(w*r, 0); compCtx.lineTo(w*r, h); compCtx.stroke();
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(0, h*r); compCtx.lineTo(w, h*r); compCtx.stroke();
        });
        compCtx.restore();
      }
      if (document.getElementById('guideSymmetry').checked) {
        compCtx.save(); compCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(59,130,246,0.65)'; compCtx.lineWidth = 1; compCtx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
        compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(w/2, 0); compCtx.lineTo(w/2, h); compCtx.stroke();
        compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(0, h/2); compCtx.lineTo(w, h/2); compCtx.stroke();
        compCtx.restore();
      }

      // Draw Auto Overlays based on Step 2 criteria & Step 5 toggle
      const showAuto = document.getElementById('toggleAutoOverlay')?.checked;
      const selected = getSelectedCriteria();
      if (showAuto && compAutoResult) {
        const r = compAutoResult;
        // Organic Silhouette Contour
        if (selected.includes('form') && r.silhouettePoly.length > 3) {
          compCtx.save();
          compCtx.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';
          compCtx.lineWidth = 2.2;
          compCtx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
          compCtx.beginPath();
          r.silhouettePoly.forEach((pt, idx) => {
            if (idx === 0) compCtx.moveTo(pt.x * w, pt.y * h);
            else compCtx.lineTo(pt.x * w, pt.y * h);
          });
          compCtx.closePath();
          compCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.07)';
          compCtx.fill();
          compCtx.stroke();
          compCtx.restore();
        }
        // Focal Zones
        if (selected.includes('focal')) {
          [r.primaryFocal, r.secondaryFocal].filter(Boolean).forEach((f, idx) => {
            compCtx.save();
            const fx = f.cx * w, fy = f.cy * h, fr = Math.min(w, h) * (idx === 0 ? 0.12 : 0.08);
            compCtx.strokeStyle = '#E11D48'; compCtx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.arc(fx, fy, fr, 0, Math.PI * 2); compCtx.stroke();
            compCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(225,29,72,0.14)'; compCtx.fill();
            compCtx.fillStyle = '#E11D48';
            compCtx.fillRect(fx - 38, fy - fr - 18, 82, 16);
            compCtx.fillStyle = '#fff'; compCtx.font = 'bold 10px Inter, sans-serif';
            compCtx.fillText(idx === 0 ? 'Trọng tâm chính' : 'Điểm nhấn phụ', fx - 34, fy - fr - 6);
            compCtx.restore();
          });
        }
        // Visual Flow Curve (Start -> Focal -> End)
        if (selected.includes('flow')) {
          compCtx.save();
          const sx = r.flow.startX * w, sy = r.flow.startY * h;
          const mx = r.flow.midX * w, my = r.flow.midY * h;
          const ex = r.flow.endX * w, ey = r.flow.endY * h;
          compCtx.strokeStyle = '#10B981'; compCtx.lineWidth = 3;
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(sx, sy); compCtx.quadraticCurveTo(mx, my, ex, ey); compCtx.stroke();
          compCtx.fillStyle = '#10B981';
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.arc(sx, sy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); compCtx.fill();
          const ang = Math.atan2(ey - my, ex - mx);
          compCtx.beginPath();
          compCtx.moveTo(ex, ey);
          compCtx.lineTo(ex - 12 * Math.cos(ang - 0.5), ey - 12 * Math.sin(ang - 0.5));
          compCtx.lineTo(ex - 12 * Math.cos(ang + 0.5), ey - 12 * Math.sin(ang + 0.5));
          compCtx.closePath(); compCtx.fill();
          compCtx.restore();
        }
      }

      // Draw User's Step 5 Manual Annotations
      const drawShape = (ann) => {
        compCtx.save();
        compCtx.strokeStyle = ann.color; compCtx.fillStyle = ann.color; compCtx.lineWidth = 3;
        const x1 = ann.x1 * w, y1 = ann.y1 * h, x2 = ann.x2 * w, y2 = ann.y2 * h;
        if (ann.tool === 'focal') {
          const rad = Math.max(14, Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1));
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.arc(x1, y1, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          compCtx.fillStyle = ann.color + '26'; compCtx.fill(); compCtx.stroke();
        } else if (ann.tool === 'flow') {
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(x1, y1); compCtx.lineTo(x2, y2); compCtx.stroke();
          const ang = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(x2, y2);
          compCtx.lineTo(x2 - 12 * Math.cos(ang - Math.PI / 6), y2 - 12 * Math.sin(ang - Math.PI / 6));
          compCtx.lineTo(x2 - 12 * Math.cos(ang + Math.PI / 6), y2 - 12 * Math.sin(ang + Math.PI / 6));
          compCtx.closePath(); compCtx.fill();
        } else if (ann.tool === 'axis') {
          compCtx.setLineDash([8, 4]); compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.moveTo(x1, y1); compCtx.lineTo(x2, y2); compCtx.stroke();
        } else if (ann.tool === 'box') {
          compCtx.strokeRect(Math.min(x1, x2), Math.min(y1, y2), Math.abs(x2 - x1), Math.abs(y2 - y1));
        } else if (ann.tool === 'pin') {
          compCtx.beginPath(); compCtx.arc(x1, y1, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); compCtx.fill();
          compCtx.font = 'bold 12px Inter, sans-serif'; compCtx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          compCtx.fillRect(x1 + 10, y1 - 12, compCtx.measureText(ann.label || 'Ghi chú').width + 10, 20);
          compCtx.fillStyle = '#1A2621'; compCtx.fillText(ann.label || 'Ghi chú', x1 + 15, y1 + 2);
        }
        compCtx.restore();
      };

      state.compAnnotations.forEach(drawShape);
      if (isDrawingComp && compStart && compCurrent && activeCompTool !== 'pan') {
        drawShape({ tool: activeCompTool, color: activeCompColor, x1: compStart.x, y1: compStart.y, x2: compCurrent.x, y2: compCurrent.y });
      }
      renderCompMetrics();
    }

    function renderCompMetrics() {
      const list = document.getElementById('compMetricsList');
      if (!state.compAnnotations.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<p class="text-[#5F6B64] italic">Chưa có nét vẽ thủ công nào.</p>';
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = state.compAnnotations.map((a, idx) => {
        const desc = a.tool === 'focal' ? 'Trọng tâm tự khoanh' : a.tool === 'axis' ? 'Trục tự vẽ' : a.tool === 'flow' ? 'Dòng chảy tự vẽ' : a.tool === 'box' ? 'Vùng tự khoanh' : `Ghim: "${a.label}"`;
        return `<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style="background:${a.color}"></span>#${idx+1} ${desc}</div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // Canvas Pointer Events (Supports Pan + Drawing)
    let isPanningComp = false, panStartX = 0, panStartY = 0;
    compCanvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (activeCompTool === 'pan') {
        isPanningComp = true;
        panStartX = e.clientX - compPanX;
        panStartY = e.clientY - compPanY;
        return;
      }
      const rect = compCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const nx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const ny = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      if (activeCompTool === 'pin') {
        showModal({
          title: 'Thêm Ghi Chú Nghiên Cứu',
          bodyHtml: `<input id="compPinText" type="text" placeholder="Ví dụ: Hoa chính đặt hơi thấp" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-[#E4DFD5] rounded-lg text-xs" />`,
          confirmText: 'Ghim lên ảnh',
          onConfirm: () => {
            const label = document.getElementById('compPinText').value.trim() || 'Ghi chú';
            state.compAnnotations.push({ tool: 'pin', color: activeCompColor, x1: nx, y1: ny, x2: nx, y2: ny, label });
            renderCompCanvas(); persist();
          }
        });
        return;
      }
      isDrawingComp = true;
      compStart = { x: nx, y: ny };
      compCurrent = { x: nx, y: ny };
    });

    compCanvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (isPanningComp) {
        compPanX = e.clientX - panStartX;
        compPanY = e.clientY - panStartY;
        updateCompZoomTransform();
        return;
      }
      if (!isDrawingComp) return;
      const rect = compCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      compCurrent = { x: (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width, y: (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height };
      renderCompCanvas();
    });

    window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      if (isPanningComp) { isPanningComp = false; return; }
      if (!isDrawingComp) return;
      isDrawingComp = false;
      state.compAnnotations.push({ tool: activeCompTool, color: activeCompColor, x1: compStart.x, y1: compStart.y, x2: compCurrent.x, y2: compCurrent.y, label: '' });
      renderCompCanvas(); persist();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.comp-tool-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.onclick = () => {
        activeCompTool = b.dataset.tool;
        compCanvas.style.cursor = activeCompTool === 'pan' ? 'grab' : 'crosshair';
        document.querySelectorAll('.comp-tool-btn').forEach(x => x.className = 'comp-tool-btn px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5] flex items-center justify-center gap-1');
        b.className = 'comp-tool-btn px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-[#1A2621] text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-1';
      };
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.comp-color-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.onclick = () => {
        activeCompColor = b.dataset.stroke;
        document.querySelectorAll('.comp-color-btn').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-offset-1', 'ring-[#1A2621]'));
        b.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-offset-1', 'ring-[#1A2621]');
      };
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.comp-crit').forEach(c => {
      c.onchange = () => { renderCompDiagnosis(); renderCompCanvas(); };
    });
    document.getElementById('btnCompSelectAll').onclick = () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.comp-crit').forEach(c => c.checked = true);
      renderCompDiagnosis(); renderCompCanvas();
    };
    ['guideThirds', 'guideGolden', 'guideSymmetry', 'toggleAutoOverlay'].forEach(id => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) el.onchange = renderCompCanvas;
    });
    document.getElementById('btnCompZoomIn').onclick = () => { compZoom = clamp(compZoom + 0.2, 0.5, 3); updateCompZoomTransform(); };
    document.getElementById('btnCompZoomOut').onclick = () => { compZoom = clamp(compZoom - 0.2, 0.5, 3); updateCompZoomTransform(); };
    document.getElementById('btnCompZoomReset').onclick = () => { compZoom = 1; compPanX = 0; compPanY = 0; updateCompZoomTransform(); };
    document.getElementById('btnToggleAutoReport').onclick = () => {
      document.getElementById('compAutoReportPanel').classList.toggle('hidden');
    };
    document.getElementById('btnCompAutoAnalyze').onclick = () => {
      analyzeFloralComposition();
      renderCompCanvas();
      document.getElementById('compAutoReportPanel').classList.remove('hidden');
      showToast('Đã phân tích trực quan theo các tiêu chí đã chọn!', 'success');
    };
    document.getElementById('btnCompUndo').onclick = () => { state.compAnnotations.pop(); renderCompCanvas(); persist(); };
    document.getElementById('btnCompClear').onclick = () => { state.compAnnotations = []; renderCompCanvas(); persist(); };
    document.getElementById('btnCompLoadFromColor').onclick = () => {
      if (state.currentImageDataUrl) loadCompImage(state.currentImageDataUrl);
      else showToast('Chưa có ảnh ở Color Studio.', 'error');
    };
    document.getElementById('btnCompUpload').onclick = () => document.getElementById('compImageInput').click();
    document.getElementById('compImageInput').onchange = (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = ev => loadCompImage(ev.target.result);
      r.readAsDataURL(f);
    };
    document.getElementById('btnCompExportPng').onclick = () => {
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.download = 'kim_flora_composition_study.png';
      link.href = compCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      link.click();
      showToast('Đã xuất ảnh nghiên cứu bố cục PNG!', 'success');
    };

    // ==================== MODULE 3 & 4: INVENTORY & RECIPE BUILDER ====================
    function renderInventory() {
      const q = document.getElementById('invSearchInput').value.toLowerCase();
      const cat = document.getElementById('invCategoryFilter').value;
      const filtered = state.inventory.filter(item => {
        const matchQ = !q || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.sku.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.supplier.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchCat = cat === 'all' || item.category === cat;
        return matchQ && matchCat;
      });

      const lowCount = state.inventory.filter(x => x.stock <= x.minStock).length;
      const totalVal = state.inventory.reduce((s, x) => s + x.cost * x.stock, 0);
      document.getElementById('invKpiBar').innerHTML = `
        <div class="panel-card p-3"><div class="text-[11px] text-[#5F6B64]">Tổng mã nguyên liệu</div><div class="mono-num text-lg font-bold">${state.inventory.length}</div></div>
        <div class="panel-card p-3"><div class="text-[11px] text-[#5F6B64]">Tổng giá trị tồn kho</div><div class="mono-num text-lg font-bold">${formatVND(totalVal)}</div></div>
        <div class="panel-card p-3"><div class="text-[11px] text-[#5F6B64]">Sắp hết hàng (≤ ngưỡng)</div><div class="mono-num text-lg font-bold ${lowCount ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-[#5A7364]'}">${lowCount} mã</div></div>
        <div class="panel-card p-3"><div class="text-[11px] text-[#5F6B64]">Liên kết Recipe Builder</div><div class="text-xs font-semibold text-[#5A7364] mt-1">Đang đồng bộ trực tiếp</div></div>
      `;

      const tbody = document.getElementById('invTableBody');
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      filtered.forEach(item => {
        const isLow = item.stock <= item.minStock;
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="py-2 px-3 mono-num text-[#5F6B64]">${item.sku}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 font-medium">${item.name}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5] text-[11px]">${item.category}</span></td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 mono-num">${formatVND(item.cost)} / ${item.unit}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 mono-num font-semibold ${isLow ? 'text-red-600' : ''}">${item.stock} ${item.unit} ${isLow ? '⚠' : ''}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 text-[#5F6B64]">${item.supplier}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 text-right space-x-1">
            <button data-id="${item.id}" class="inv-plus px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#F7F4EF] hover:bg-[#EAE5DC] text-[11px]">+5</button>
            <button data-id="${item.id}" class="inv-del px-2 py-1 rounded bg-red-50 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100 text-[11px]">Xóa</button>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      tbody.querySelectorAll('.inv-plus').forEach(b => {
        b.onclick = () => {
          const item = state.inventory.find(x => x.id === b.dataset.id);
          if (item) { item.stock += 5; persist(); renderInventory(); renderRecipe(); }
        };
      });
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.inv-del').forEach(b => {
        b.onclick = () => {
          state.inventory = state.inventory.filter(x => x.id !== b.dataset.id);
          persist(); renderInventory(); renderRecipe();
        };
      });
    }

    document.getElementById('invSearchInput').oninput = renderInventory;
    document.getElementById('invCategoryFilter').onchange = renderInventory;
    document.getElementById('btnExportInvCsv').onclick = () => {
      const csv = ['SKU,Ten,Nhom,DonVi,GiaVon,TonKho,NhaCungCap']
        .concat(state.inventory.map(x => `${x.sku},"${x.name}","${x.category}",${x.unit},${x.cost},${x.stock},"${x.supplier}"`))
        .join('\n');
      downloadFile('kim_flora_inventory.csv', csv, 'text/csv;charset=utf-8');
      showToast('Đã xuất danh sách kho CSV!', 'success');
    };

    document.getElementById('btnAddInvModal').onclick = () => {
      showModal({
        title: 'Nhập Nguyên Liệu Mới Vào Kho',
        bodyHtml: `
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <input id="mSku" placeholder="Mã SKU (VD: FL-PEO-13)" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
            <select id="mCat" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg"><option>Hoa chính</option><option>Hoa phụ</option><option>Lá &amp; Cành</option><option>Phụ liệu &amp; Bình</option></select>
            <input id="mName" placeholder="Tên nguyên liệu" class="col-span-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
            <input id="mUnit" value="Cành" placeholder="Đơn vị" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
            <input id="mCost" type="number" placeholder="Giá vốn (VNĐ)" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
            <input id="mStock" type="number" placeholder="Số lượng nhập" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
            <input id="mSup" placeholder="Nhà cung cấp" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 border rounded-lg" />
          </div>`,
        confirmText: 'Thêm vào kho',
        onConfirm: () => {
          const name = document.getElementById('mName').value.trim();
          if (!name) return;
          state.inventory.unshift({
            id: 'inv-' + Date.now(),
            sku: document.getElementById('mSku').value.trim() || 'SKU-NEW',
            name,
            category: document.getElementById('mCat').value,
            unit: document.getElementById('mUnit').value.trim() || 'Cành',
            cost: Number(document.getElementById('mCost').value) || 0,
            stock: Number(document.getElementById('mStock').value) || 0,
            minStock: 5,
            supplier: document.getElementById('mSup').value.trim() || 'Nội bộ'
          });
          persist(); renderInventory(); renderRecipe();
          showToast('Đã thêm nguyên liệu mới vào kho!', 'success');
        }
      });
    };

    function renderRecipe() {
      const r = state.recipe;
      document.getElementById('recipeNameInput').value = r.name;
      document.getElementById('recipeBatchQty').value = r.batchQty;
      document.getElementById('costLaborPct').value = r.laborPct;
      document.getElementById('costWastePct').value = r.wastePct;
      document.getElementById('costOverheadFixed').value = r.overheadFixed;
      document.getElementById('costMarginPct').value = r.marginPct;

      const picker = document.getElementById('recipeInvPicker');
      picker.innerHTML = state.inventory.map(inv => `<option value="${inv.id}">${inv.name} (${formatVND(inv.cost)}/${inv.unit} · Tồn: ${inv.stock})</option>`).join('');

      const tbody = document.getElementById('recipeTableBody');
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      let matCostPerUnit = 0;
      const shortages = [];

      r.items.forEach((line, idx) => {
        const inv = state.inventory.find(x => x.id === line.invId);
        if (!inv) return;
        const lineCost = inv.cost * line.qty;
        matCostPerUnit += lineCost;
        const totalNeed = line.qty * r.batchQty;
        const diff = inv.stock - totalNeed;
        if (diff < 0) shortages.push({ inv, needMore: Math.abs(diff) });

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="py-2 px-3 font-medium">${inv.name}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 mono-num">${formatVND(inv.cost)}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2"><input type="number" min="1" value="${line.qty}" data-idx="${idx}" class="rec-qty mono-num w-14 px-1.5 py-1 border border-[#E4DFD5] rounded text-center" /></td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 mono-num font-semibold">${totalNeed} ${inv.unit}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 mono-num">${inv.stock} ${inv.unit}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2">${diff >= 0 ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 text-[11px]">Đủ kho</span>' : `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 text-[11px]">Thiếu ${Math.abs(diff)}</span>`}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 text-right mono-num font-semibold">${formatVND(lineCost)}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-2 text-right"><button data-idx="${idx}" class="rec-del text-red-600 hover:underline text-[11px]">Xóa</button></td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      tbody.querySelectorAll('.rec-qty').forEach(el => {
        el.oninput = (e) => { r.items[+e.target.dataset.idx].qty = Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value) || 1); persist(); renderRecipe(); };
      });
      tbody.querySelectorAll('.rec-del').forEach(el => {
        el.onclick = (e) => { r.items.splice(+e.target.dataset.idx, 1); persist(); renderRecipe(); };
      });

      // Costing Math
      const labor = matCostPerUnit * (r.laborPct / 100);
      const waste = matCostPerUnit * (r.wastePct / 100);
      const cogs = matCostPerUnit + labor + waste + Number(r.overheadFixed || 0);
      const marginDec = clamp(r.marginPct, 1, 95) / 100;
      const suggestedPrice = cogs / (1 - marginDec);
      const netProfit = suggestedPrice - cogs;

      document.getElementById('costMaterials').textContent = formatVND(matCostPerUnit);
      document.getElementById('costTotalCogs').textContent = formatVND(cogs);
      document.getElementById('costSuggestedPrice').textContent = formatVND(suggestedPrice);
      document.getElementById('costNetProfit').textContent = formatVND(netProfit);
      document.getElementById('costBatchCountLabel').textContent = r.batchQty;
      document.getElementById('costTotalOrderRevenue').textContent = formatVND(suggestedPrice * r.batchQty);
      document.getElementById('costMarkupInfo').textContent = `Biên LN ${r.marginPct}%`;
      document.getElementById('recipeCategoryInput').value = r.category || 'Bó hoa bất đối xứng';
      document.getElementById('recipeSizeInput').value = r.size || 'M';
      document.getElementById('recipeBudgetInput').value = r.budget || 1800000;
      document.getElementById('recipeStepsInput').value = r.steps || '';
      if (r.photo) {
        document.getElementById('recipePhotoPreview').src = r.photo;
        document.getElementById('recipePhotoPreviewBox').classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        document.getElementById('recipePhotoPreviewBox').classList.add('hidden');
      }
      updateRecipeProportionsAndBudget(cogs, suggestedPrice);
      renderSavedRecipesList();

      const shortEl = document.getElementById('shortageListContainer');
      if (!shortages.length) {
        shortEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-[#5A7364] font-medium">✓ Kho hiện tại đáp ứng đủ toàn bộ nguyên liệu cho công thức này.</p>';
      } else {
        shortEl.innerHTML = shortages.map(s => `<div class="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-[#E4DFD5]"><span>${s.inv.name} (${s.inv.supplier})</span><strong class="text-red-600 mono-num">Cần mua thêm: ${s.needMore} ${s.inv.unit} (~${formatVND(s.needMore * s.inv.cost)})</strong></div>`).join('');
      }
    }

    ['recipeNameInput', 'recipeBatchQty', 'costLaborPct', 'costWastePct', 'costOverheadFixed', 'costMarginPct'].forEach(id => {
      document.getElementById(id).oninput = () => {
        state.recipe.name = document.getElementById('recipeNameInput').value;
        state.recipe.batchQty = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('recipeBatchQty').value) || 1);
        state.recipe.laborPct = Number(document.getElementById('costLaborPct').value) || 0;
        state.recipe.wastePct = Number(document.getElementById('costWastePct').value) || 0;
        state.recipe.overheadFixed = Number(document.getElementById('costOverheadFixed').value) || 0;
        state.recipe.marginPct = clamp(Number(document.getElementById('costMarginPct').value) || 10, 1, 95);
        persist();
        renderRecipe();
      };
    });
    document.getElementById('btnAddRecipeItem').onclick = () => {
      const invId = document.getElementById('recipeInvPicker').value;
      const qty = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('recipeAddQty').value) || 1);
      const existing = state.recipe.items.find(x => x.invId === invId);
      if (existing) existing.qty += qty;
      else state.recipe.items.push({ invId, qty });
      persist(); renderRecipe();
    };
    document.getElementById('btnDeductInventory').onclick = () => {
      showModal({
        title: 'Xác nhận Trừ Kho Theo Công Thức',
        bodyHtml: `<p>Hệ thống sẽ trừ tồn kho của <strong>${state.recipe.items.length}</strong> loại nguyên liệu nhân cho <strong>${state.recipe.batchQty}</strong> sản phẩm.</p>`,
        confirmText: 'Trừ kho ngay',
        onConfirm: () => {
          state.recipe.items.forEach(line => {
            const inv = state.inventory.find(x => x.id === line.invId);
            if (inv) inv.stock = Math.max(0, inv.stock - line.qty * state.recipe.batchQty);
          });
          persist(); renderRecipe(); renderInventory();
          showToast('Đã cập nhật trừ kho thành công!', 'success');
        }
      });
    };
    document.getElementById('btnExportShoppingList').onclick = () => {
      const lines = ['PHIEU MUA HANG THIEU - KIM FLORA', `Cong thuc: ${state.recipe.name} (x${state.recipe.batchQty})`, '---'];
      state.recipe.items.forEach(line => {
        const inv = state.inventory.find(x => x.id === line.invId);
        if (!inv) return;
        const need = line.qty * state.recipe.batchQty - inv.stock;
        if (need > 0) lines.push(`- ${inv.name}: Mua ${need} ${inv.unit} | NCC: ${inv.supplier} | Du kien: ${formatVND(need * inv.cost)}`);
      });
      if (lines.length === 3) lines.push('Khong co nguyen lieu thieu.');
      downloadFile('phieu_mua_hang_kim_flora.txt', lines.join('\n'));
      showToast('Đã xuất phiếu mua hàng!', 'success');
    };

    // ==================== MODULE 5: FREEFORM MOODBOARD ====================
    const mbViewport = document.getElementById('mbViewport');
    const mbStage = document.getElementById('mbStage');
    let mbZoom = 1, mbPanX = 0, mbPanY = 0, selectedMbId = null;

    function updateMbTransform() {
      mbStage.style.transform = `translate(${mbPanX}px, ${mbPanY}px) scale(${mbZoom})`;
      document.getElementById('mbZoomLabel').textContent = Math.round(mbZoom * 100) + '%';
    }

    function renderMoodboard() {
      mbStage.innerHTML = '';
      state.moodboardItems.forEach(item => {
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = `mb-item ${item.id === selectedMbId ? 'selected' : ''}`;
        el.style.left = item.x + 'px';
        el.style.top = item.y + 'px';
        el.style.width = item.w + 'px';
        el.style.height = item.h + 'px';
        el.style.zIndex = item.z || 1;
        el.style.transform = `rotate(${item.rotate || 0}deg)`;
        el.dataset.id = item.id;

        if (item.type === 'image') {
          el.innerHTML = `<img src="${item.src}" class="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-lg shadow-md pointer-events-none" /><div class="mb-resize-handle"></div>`;
        } else if (item.type === 'note') {
          el.innerHTML = `<textarea class="w-full h-full p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-amber-300 shadow-md text-xs text-[#1A2621] resize-none focus:outline-none">${item.text || ''}</textarea><div class="mb-resize-handle"></div>`;
          el.querySelector('textarea').oninput = (e) => { item.text = e.target.value; persist(); };
        } else if (item.type === 'text') {
          el.innerHTML = `<div contenteditable="true" class="w-full h-full font-editorial font-semibold outline-none" style="font-size:${item.fontSize || 20}px;color:${item.color || '#1A2621'}">${item.text || 'Tiêu đề'}</div><div class="mb-resize-handle"></div>`;
          el.querySelector('[contenteditable]').oninput = (e) => { item.text = e.target.innerText; persist(); };
        } else if (item.type === 'palette') {
          const swatches = (item.colors || []).map(c => `<div class="flex-1 h-full" style="background:${c}"></div>`).join('');
          el.innerHTML = `<div class="w-full h-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-md border border-black/10 flex flex-col bg-white"><div class="flex-1 flex">${swatches}</div><div class="px-2 py-1 text-[10px] mono-num text-[#5F6B64] truncate">${(item.colors || []).join(' · ')}</div></div><div class="mb-resize-handle"></div>`;
        }

        // Drag & Resize
        el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          selectedMbId = item.id;
          document.querySelectorAll('.mb-item').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('selected'));
          el.classList.add('selected');
          document.getElementById('mbSelectionTools').classList.remove('opacity-40', 'pointer-events-none');

          if (e.target.classList.contains('mb-resize-handle')) {
            const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY, origW = item.w, origH = item.h;
            const onMove = (ev) => {
              item.w = Math.max(80, origW + (ev.clientX - startX) / mbZoom);
              item.h = Math.max(50, origH + (ev.clientY - startY) / mbZoom);
              el.style.width = item.w + 'px';
              el.style.height = item.h + 'px';
            };
            const onUp = () => { window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove); window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp); persist(); };
            window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
            window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
          } else if (!['TEXTAREA'].includes(e.target.tagName)) {
            const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY, origX = item.x, origY = item.y;
            const onMove = (ev) => {
              item.x = origX + (ev.clientX - startX) / mbZoom;
              item.y = origY + (ev.clientY - startY) / mbZoom;
              el.style.left = item.x + 'px';
              el.style.top = item.y + 'px';
            };
            const onUp = () => { window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove); window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp); persist(); };
            window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
            window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
          }
        });
        mbStage.appendChild(el);
      });
      updateMbTransform();
    }

    // Pan viewport
    mbViewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (e.target !== mbViewport && e.target !== mbStage) return;
      selectedMbId = null;
      document.querySelectorAll('.mb-item').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('selected'));
      document.getElementById('mbSelectionTools').classList.add('opacity-40', 'pointer-events-none');
      const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY, origPX = mbPanX, origPY = mbPanY;
      const onMove = (ev) => { mbPanX = origPX + (ev.clientX - startX); mbPanY = origPY + (ev.clientY - startY); updateMbTransform(); };
      const onUp = () => { window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove); window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp); };
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
    });

    document.getElementById('btnMbZoomIn').onclick = () => { mbZoom = clamp(mbZoom + 0.15, 0.3, 2.5); updateMbTransform(); };
    document.getElementById('btnMbZoomOut').onclick = () => { mbZoom = clamp(mbZoom - 0.15, 0.3, 2.5); updateMbTransform(); };
    document.getElementById('btnMbResetView').onclick = () => { mbZoom = 1; mbPanX = 0; mbPanY = 0; updateMbTransform(); };

    document.getElementById('btnMbAddNote').onclick = () => {
      state.moodboardItems.push({ id: 'mb-' + Date.now(), type: 'note', x: 120, y: 120, w: 220, h: 140, rotate: 0, z: state.moodboardItems.length + 1, text: 'Ghi chú ý tưởng mới...' });
      persist(); renderMoodboard();
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbAddText').onclick = () => {
      state.moodboardItems.push({ id: 'mb-' + Date.now(), type: 'text', x: 140, y: 80, w: 280, h: 50, rotate: 0, z: state.moodboardItems.length + 1, text: 'TIÊU ĐỀ BỘ SƯU TẬP', fontSize: 22, color: '#1A2621' });
      persist(); renderMoodboard();
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbAddImage').onclick = () => document.getElementById('mbImageInput').click();
    document.getElementById('mbImageInput').onchange = (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = ev => {
        state.moodboardItems.push({ id: 'mb-' + Date.now(), type: 'image', x: 180, y: 140, w: 260, h: 200, rotate: 0, z: state.moodboardItems.length + 1, src: ev.target.result });
        persist(); renderMoodboard();
      };
      r.readAsDataURL(f);
    };

    function importPaletteToMoodboard() {
      state.moodboardItems.push({
        id: 'mb-' + Date.now(),
        type: 'palette',
        x: 100, y: 310, w: 320, h: 95, rotate: 0, z: state.moodboardItems.length + 1,
        colors: state.palette.map(p => p.hex)
      });
      persist(); renderMoodboard();
      showToast('Đã nạp bảng màu vào Moodboard!', 'success');
    }
    document.getElementById('btnMbImportPalette').onclick = importPaletteToMoodboard;

    document.getElementById('btnMbBringFront').onclick = () => {
      const it = state.moodboardItems.find(x => x.id === selectedMbId);
      if (it) { it.z = Math.max(...state.moodboardItems.map(x => x.z || 1)) + 1; persist(); renderMoodboard(); }
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbSendBack').onclick = () => {
      const it = state.moodboardItems.find(x => x.id === selectedMbId);
      if (it) { it.z = 1; persist(); renderMoodboard(); }
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbRotate').onclick = () => {
      const it = state.moodboardItems.find(x => x.id === selectedMbId);
      if (it) { it.rotate = ((it.rotate || 0) + 15) % 360; persist(); renderMoodboard(); }
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbDeleteItem').onclick = () => {
      state.moodboardItems = state.moodboardItems.filter(x => x.id !== selectedMbId);
      selectedMbId = null; persist(); renderMoodboard();
    };
    document.getElementById('btnMbExportPng').onclick = () => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 1200; c.height = 800;
      const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FAF8F4'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1200, 800);
      const sorted = [...state.moodboardItems].sort((a, b) => (a.z || 1) - (b.z || 1));
      sorted.forEach(it => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(it.x + it.w/2, it.y + it.h/2);
        ctx.rotate((it.rotate || 0) * Math.PI / 180);
        if (it.type === 'note') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#FEF3C7'; ctx.fillRect(-it.w/2, -it.h/2, it.w, it.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#1A2621'; ctx.font = '13px Inter, sans-serif';
          ctx.fillText((it.text || '').slice(0, 45), -it.w/2 + 10, -it.h/2 + 24);
        } else if (it.type === 'text') {
          ctx.fillStyle = it.color || '#1A2621'; ctx.font = `bold ${it.fontSize || 20}px Georgia, serif`;
          ctx.fillText(it.text || '', -it.w/2, 0);
        } else if (it.type === 'palette') {
          const cols = it.colors || [];
          const sw = it.w / Math.max(1, cols.length);
          cols.forEach((col, i) => { ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(-it.w/2 + i*sw, -it.h/2, sw, it.h); });
        }
        ctx.restore();
      });
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.download = 'kim_flora_moodboard.png'; a.href = c.toDataURL('image/png'); a.click();
      showToast('Đã xuất Moodboard PNG!', 'success');
    };

    // ==================== MODULE 6: PROJECT ARCHIVE ====================
    function saveFullProject() {
      state.projectName = document.getElementById('projNameInput').value.trim() || 'Dự án Kim Flora';
      state.projectClient = document.getElementById('projClientInput').value.trim();
      state.projectBrief = document.getElementById('projBriefInput').value.trim();
      document.getElementById('activeProjectName').textContent = 'Dự án: ' + state.projectName;

      state.savedProjects.unshift({
        id: 'prj-' + Date.now(),
        name: state.projectName,
        client: state.projectClient,
        brief: state.projectBrief,
        updatedAt: new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN'),
        palette: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.palette)),
        recipe: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.recipe)),
        compAnnotations: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.compAnnotations))
      });
      persist();
      renderProjectsArchive();
      showToast('Đã lưu toàn bộ dự án vào kho lưu trữ!', 'success');
    }

    document.getElementById('btnQuickSaveProject').onclick = saveFullProject;
    document.getElementById('btnSaveFullProject').onclick = saveFullProject;

    function renderProjectsArchive() {
      document.getElementById('projNameInput').value = state.projectName;
      document.getElementById('projClientInput').value = state.projectClient;
      document.getElementById('projBriefInput').value = state.projectBrief;

      const pGrid = document.getElementById('savedProjectsGrid');
      pGrid.innerHTML = state.savedProjects.length ? state.savedProjects.map((p, idx) => `
        <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5] space-y-2">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
            <div>
              <div class="font-semibold text-xs">${p.name}</div>
              <div class="text-[11px] text-[#5F6B64]">${p.client || 'Nội bộ'} · ${p.updatedAt}</div>
            </div>
            <button data-idx="${idx}" class="prj-load px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#1A2621] text-white text-[11px]">Mở</button>
          </div>
          <div class="flex h-4 rounded overflow-hidden border border-black/10">${(p.palette||[]).map(c => `<div class="flex-1" style="background:${c.hex}"></div>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('') : '<p class="text-xs text-[#5F6B64]">Chưa có dự án nào được lưu. Nhấn "Lưu Dự Án" ở góc trên để lưu.</p>';

      pGrid.querySelectorAll('.prj-load').forEach(b => {
        b.onclick = () => {
          const p = state.savedProjects[+b.dataset.idx];
          if (!p) return;
          state.projectName = p.name; state.projectClient = p.client; state.projectBrief = p.brief;
          state.palette = p.palette; state.recipe = p.recipe; state.compAnnotations = p.compAnnotations || [];
          renderColorStudio(); renderRecipe(); renderCompCanvas();
          showToast(`Đã nạp dự án "${p.name}"!`, 'success');
        };
      });

      const crGrid = document.getElementById('savedColorRecipesGrid');
      crGrid.innerHTML = state.savedColorRecipes.length ? state.savedColorRecipes.map((cr, idx) => `
        <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5] space-y-2">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
            <strong class="text-xs">${cr.name}</strong>
            <button data-idx="${idx}" class="cr-load text-[11px] text-[#A65A42] font-semibold hover:underline">Áp dụng</button>
          </div>
          ${cr.image ? `<img src="${cr.image}" class="w-full h-auto max-h-44 object-contain bg-white rounded-lg" />` : ''}
          <div class="flex h-5 rounded overflow-hidden">${cr.palette.map(c => `<div class="flex-1" style="background:${c.hex}" title="${c.hex} (${c.ratio}%)"></div>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('') : '<p class="text-xs text-[#5F6B64]">Chưa có công thức màu riêng nào được lưu.</p>';

      crGrid.querySelectorAll('.cr-load').forEach(b => {
        b.onclick = () => {
          const cr = state.savedColorRecipes[+b.dataset.idx];
          if (!cr) return;
          state.palette = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cr.palette));
          loadColorRecipeSource(cr);
          renderColorStudio();
          document.querySelector('[data-tab="color"]').click();
        };
      });
    }

    document.getElementById('btnBackupAllJson').onclick = () => {
      downloadFile('kim_flora_backup.json', JSON.stringify(state, null, 2), 'application/json');
      showToast('Đã xuất file sao lưu JSON!', 'success');
    };
    document.getElementById('btnRestoreJson').onclick = () => document.getElementById('restoreJsonInput').click();
    document.getElementById('restoreJsonInput').onchange = (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = ev => {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(ev.target.result);
          state = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_STATE, parsed);
          persist();
          renderColorStudio(); renderInventory(); renderRecipe(); renderProjectsArchive();
          showToast('Khôi phục dữ liệu thành công!', 'success');
        } catch (err) { showToast('File JSON không hợp lệ.', 'error'); }
      };
      r.readAsText(f);
    };

    // ==================== MODULE 2B: FLORAL DESIGN MOODBOARD ====================
    async function openDesignResearch() {
      const host = document.getElementById('tab-designmood');
      if (host.dataset.research) return;
      host.dataset.research = 'loading';

      const status = document.createElement('p');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.textContent = 'Đang mở trình chỉnh ảnh…';
      host.replaceChildren(status);

      try {
        const { mount } = await import('/moodboard-research.js');
        host.replaceChildren();
        mount(host, state.designMoodboard?.images, {
          palette(colors) {
            state.palette = colors.map((color, index) => ({
              id: crypto.randomUUID(),
              hex: color.hex,
              ratio: color.percent,
              imgArea: color.percent,
              locked: false,
              name: 'Màu ảnh ' + (index + 1)
            }));
            normalizeRatios();
            renderColorStudio();
            persist();
            document.querySelector('[data-tab="color"]').click();
          },
          recipe(plan) {
            state.recipe.name = plan.name;
            state.recipe.steps = [plan.idea, plan.form, plan.materials, plan.make].join('\n');
            persist();
            renderRecipe();
            document.querySelector('[data-tab="recipe"]').click();
          }
        });
        host.dataset.research = 'ready';
      } catch (error) {
        delete host.dataset.research;
        status.textContent = 'Chưa mở được trình chỉnh ảnh. Hãy chọn lại tab để thử lại.';
        host.replaceChildren(status);
        console.error('Floral Design Moodboard', error);
      }
    }

    // ==================== ENHANCED RECIPE BUILDER HELPERS ====================
    function updateRecipeProportionsAndBudget(totalCogs, suggestedPrice) {
      const r = state.recipe;
      const groups = { 'Hoa chính': 0, 'Hoa phụ': 0, 'Lá & Cành': 0, 'Phụ liệu & Bình': 0 };
      let totalQty = 0;
      r.items.forEach(line => {
        const inv = state.inventory.find(x => x.id === line.invId);
        if (!inv) return;
        groups[inv.category] = (groups[inv.category] || 0) + line.qty;
        totalQty += line.qty;
      });
      const sizeTargets = { S: 15, M: 25, L: 40, XL: 65 };
      const sz = document.getElementById('recipeSizeInput')?.value || 'M';
      document.getElementById('recipeTotalStemsLabel').textContent = `${totalQty} đơn vị/SP`;
      document.getElementById('recipeStemTargetHint').textContent = `(Gợi ý Size ${sz}: ~${sizeTargets[sz]} cành/đơn vị)`;

      const budget = Number(document.getElementById('recipeBudgetInput')?.value) || 0;
      const bEl = document.getElementById('recipeBudgetStatus');
      if (budget > 0) {
        if (suggestedPrice <= budget) bEl.innerHTML = `<span class="text-[#5A7364]">✓ Đạt ngân sách (Dư ${formatVND(budget - suggestedPrice)})</span>`;
        else bEl.innerHTML = `<span class="text-red-600">⚠ Vượt ngân sách ${formatVND(suggestedPrice - budget)}</span>`;
      }

      const colors = { 'Hoa chính': '#A65A42', 'Hoa phụ': '#E2A98E', 'Lá & Cành': '#5A7364', 'Phụ liệu & Bình': '#1A2621' };
      const bar = document.getElementById('recipeGroupRatioBar');
      const leg = document.getElementById('recipeGroupRatioLegend');
      if (bar && leg) {
        const denom = totalQty || 1;
        bar.innerHTML = Object.keys(groups).map(k => `<div style="width:${(groups[k]/denom)*100}%;background:${colors[k]}"></div>`).join('');
        leg.innerHTML = Object.keys(groups).map(k => `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style="background:${colors[k]}"></span>${k}: <strong>${Math.round((groups[k]/denom)*100)}%</strong> (${groups[k]})</span>`).join('');
      }
    }

    function renderSavedRecipesList() {
      const list = state.savedRecipes || [];
      document.getElementById('savedRecipesCount').textContent = `${list.length} mẫu`;
      const el = document.getElementById('savedRecipesList');
      el.innerHTML = list.length ? list.map((rec, idx) => `
        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#F7F4EF] border border-[#E4DFD5] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            ${rec.photo ? `<img src="${rec.photo}" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0" />` : ''}
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <div class="font-semibold truncate">${rec.name}</div>
              <div class="text-[10px] text-[#5F6B64]">${rec.category} · Size ${rec.size || 'M'}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button data-idx="${idx}" class="rec-lib-load px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#1A2621] text-white text-[11px] shrink-0">Mở</button>
        </div>
      `).join('') : '<p class="text-xs text-[#5F6B64]">Chưa có công thức mẫu nào được lưu.</p>';

      el.querySelectorAll('.rec-lib-load').forEach(b => {
        b.onclick = () => {
          const rec = state.savedRecipes[+b.dataset.idx];
          if (!rec) return;
          state.recipe = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rec));
          persist(); renderRecipe();
          showToast(`Đã nạp công thức "${rec.name}"!`, 'success');
        };
      });
    }

    document.getElementById('btnRecipeUploadPhoto').onclick = () => document.getElementById('recipePhotoInput').click();
    document.getElementById('recipePhotoInput').onchange = (e) => {
      const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = ev => {
        state.recipe.photo = ev.target.result;
        document.getElementById('recipePhotoPreview').src = ev.target.result;
        document.getElementById('recipePhotoPreviewBox').classList.remove('hidden');
        persist();
      };
      r.readAsDataURL(f);
    };
    document.getElementById('recipeStepsInput').oninput = (e) => { state.recipe.steps = e.target.value; persist(); };
    document.getElementById('recipeCategoryInput').onchange = (e) => { state.recipe.category = e.target.value; persist(); };
    document.getElementById('recipeSizeInput').onchange = (e) => { state.recipe.size = e.target.value; persist(); renderRecipe(); };
    document.getElementById('recipeBudgetInput').oninput = (e) => { state.recipe.budget = Number(e.target.value) || 0; persist(); renderRecipe(); };
    document.getElementById('btnSaveRecipeSample').onclick = () => {
      const snap = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.recipe));
      snap.savedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN');
      state.savedRecipes.unshift(snap);
      persist(); renderSavedRecipesList();
      showToast('Đã lưu công thức mẫu kèm ảnh thành phẩm!', 'success');
    };

    // ==================== INITIALIZATION ====================
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      renderColorStudio();
      renderInventory();
      renderRecipe();
      renderProjectsArchive();

      // Load default sample image into Color Studio & Composition Analyzer on first open
      const sample1 = document.getElementById('sampleImgBouquet');
      if (sample1 && sample1.src) {
        if (sample1.complete) {
          loadImageToColorStudio(sample1.src);
          loadCompImage(sample1.src);
        } else {
          sample1.onload = () => {
            loadImageToColorStudio(sample1.src);
            loadCompImage(sample1.src);
          };
        }
      }
      if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    });
  })();
